magnesium_potential_file_subtask_quenchi.name: Magnesium Potential File for Quenching
magnesium_potential_file_subtask_quenchi.description: Procure the appropriate Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file for Magnesium for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

magnesium_npt_cooling_subtask_quenching.name: Magnesium NPT Cooling
magnesium_npt_cooling_subtask_quenching.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible molten Magnesium structure and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate quenching process of Magnesium by cooling its molten structure under NPT conditions with the given simulation parameters. Return the absolute path of the cooled structure and the density in gm/cm^3.
magnesium_npt_cooling_subtask_quenching.submission_format: {"density": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"density": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/structure.dat"}

magnesium_npt_relaxation_subtask_quenchi.name: Magnesium NPT Relaxation for Quenching
magnesium_npt_relaxation_subtask_quenchi.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Magnesium structure and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, relax the structure under NPT conditions with the given simulation parameters. Return the absolute path of the equilibrated structure and density in gm/cm^3.
magnesium_npt_relaxation_subtask_quenchi.submission_format: {"density": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"density": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/structure.dat"}

magnesium_nvt_relaxation_subtask_quenchi.name: Magnesium NVT Relaxation for Quenching
magnesium_nvt_relaxation_subtask_quenchi.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Magnesium structure and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, relax the structure under NVT conditions with the given simulation parameters. Report the final density in g/cm^3.
